records.source_span: My current phone number is 512-847-3291. It's a Texas area code, which I love — feels like a proper fresh start after leaving Illinois. This is my primary number for literally everything, so please keep it noted.

I strongly prefer texts over phone calls. I find ringing phones really intrusive. Texts let me respond on my own schedule, which I appreciate.
